fixesApplied.description: Added upsertPersistentMatch(), backfillMatchesFromPlacedBets(), and reconstructMatchFromDb() to provide authoritative PostgreSQL persistence for every live match and historical placed bet.
Added upsertPersistentMatch(m) alongside cacheCanonicalMatchState() to continuously sync active and completed matches to PostgreSQL.
Updated /api/v1/matches/:id with multi-tier lookup (Live Map -> Redis -> PostgreSQL -> Provider) and explicit eventStatus response contract.
Updated buildMatchOddsPayload to fall back to Redis and DB, returning NO_LONGER_LIVE (200) instead of throwing 404 for concluded events.
Added persistedMatchFallback state and asynchronous fallback effect to fetch /api/v1/matches/:id when a selected fixture is absent from the live board.
